verdict.rationale: Qdrant is an API-driven service that starts headlessly with a single documented `docker run` command, so automation can drive it entirely through client libraries. Community users note an in-memory, sqlite-like mode that makes POCs easy, plus small portable binaries, and Qdrant Edge runs in-process with no background services. Together these suit scripted and CI use. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions/service-container recipes, test fixtures), and independent hands-on reports of using it in CI pipelines.
